The output stage runs at about 22 uA. GBW is gm1/Cc. A larger Rz places an LHP zero on the gm6/CL pole, recovering PM above 70 deg with modest gm6."}

PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (20.0, 14.0, 24.0),     # input pair (weak inversion, efficiency)
    "L1":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),
    "gmid3": (12.0, 8.0, 15.0),      # PMOS mirror / output device gm/Id
    "L3":    (0.5, 0.3, 1.0),
    "I6":    (22e-6, 14e-6, 25e-6),  # output stage current
    "gmid7": (13.0, 9.0, 18.0),      # NMOS sink (low vdsat for swing)
    "L7":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),
    "I9":    (2e-6, 1e-6, 4e-6),     # replica bias branch
    "Cc":    (0.65e-12, 0.3e-12, 1.5e-12),
    "rzf":   (1.0, 0.6, 1.8),        # Rz scale vs zero-on-p2 value
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    CL = spec.get("cl", 2e-12)
    Itail = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)          # IREF used directly as tail current
    Id1 = Itail / 2

    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], Id1, vds=0.5)
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmid3"], p["L3"], Id1, vds=m3_vds if False else 0.9)
    m6 = lut.size("p", p["gmid3"], p["L3"], p["I6"], vds=0.9)
    m9 = lut.size("p", p["gmid3"], p["L3"], p["I9"], vds=0.9)
    m7 = lut.size("n", p["gmid7"], p["L7"], p["I6"], vds=0.9)
    m8 = lut.size("n", p["gmid7"], p["L7"], p["I9"], vds=m7.vgs)

    Cc = p["Cc"]
    C1 = m6.cgg + m3.cdd + m1.cdd + m3.cgd
    Rz = p["rzf"] * (1.0 / m6.gm) * (1.0 + (CL + C1) / Cc)

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    # first stage: tail = ibias node (ideal IREF from VDD)
    n.dev("M1", "vo1", "vinp", "ibias", "vss", m1)     # vinp side -> vo1 (non-inverting overall)
    n.dev("M2", "vd",  "vinn", "ibias", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "vd",  "vd",  "vdd", "vdd", m3)        # diode
    n.dev("M4", "vo1", "vd",  "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    # bias replica: PMOS mirror of M3 -> NMOS diode -> output sink
    n.dev("M9", "nb", "vd", "vdd", "vdd", m9)
    n.dev("M8", "nb", "nb", "vss", "vss", m8)
    # output stage
    n.dev("M6", "vout", "vo1", "vdd", "vdd", m6)
    n.dev("M7", "vout", "nb", "vss", "vss", m7)
    # compensation (LHP zero)
    n.R("Rz", "vo1", "xc", Rz)
    n.C("Cc", "xc", "vout", Cc)

    # predictions
    A1 = m1.gm / (m1.gds + m3.gds)
    A2 = m6.gm / (m6.gds + m7.gds)
    A0 = A1 * A2
    wu = m1.gm / Cc
    ugbw = wu / (2 * PI)
    p2 = m6.gm * Cc / (C1 * CL + Cc * (C1 + CL))
    z = 1.0 / (Cc * (Rz - 1.0 / m6.gm))
    p3 = 1.0 / (Rz * C1)
    pmir = m3.gm / (2 * m3.cgg + m1.cdd)
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(wu / p2)) + math.degrees(math.atan(wu / z)) \
         - math.degrees(math.atan(wu / p3)) - math.degrees(math.atan(wu / pmir)) \
         + math.degrees(math.atan(wu / (2 * pmir)))
    power = 1.8 * (Itail + p["I9"] + p["I6"])
    slew = min(Itail / Cc, p["I6"] / (CL + Cc))
    settle = 2 * 0.9 / slew * 0 + 0.5 / slew + 5.0 / wu
    kT = 1.38e-23 * 300
    noise_th = math.sqrt(2 * 4 * kT * (2 / 3) / m1.gm * (1 + m3.gm / m1.gm))
    swing = 1.8 - m7.vdsat - m6.vdsat - 0.05
    return n, {"gain_db": db(A0), "ugbw": ugbw, "pm": pm, "power": power,
               "slew": slew, "settle": settle, "noise_1k": 3 * noise_th,
               "swing": swing, "cmrr_db": db(A0) + 10, "psrr_db": db(A0)}
